reason: I have never heard of REPAIHUB and I only move money through my own bank's NRI desk. My NRO balance is small, so I would not risk it with a new company over a few hundred dollars of savings.
objection: I am not sure about the tax side in India and Canada, and I do not want a company I do not know touching my money. Even with the free CA call, I would rather ask my own bank or my own accountant.
would_change_my_mind: If my own Indian bank or a big Canadian bank referred me to them or offered the service itself, and a CA I could check confirmed in writing what tax I owe in India and what I must report in Canada.
